name: Write short emails
content: When drafting an email, always keep it under 5 sentences. Use bullet points if necessary. Do not include a formal sign-off.

name: Format meeting notes
content: Format meeting notes with three sections: 1. Attendees, 2. Key Decisions, 3. Action Items (with assignees and due dates).

name: Summarize articles
content: When asked to summarize an article, provide a 1-sentence tl;dr at the top, followed by 3 key takeaways.
